input.command: ls graphify-out/graph.json; graphify affected "getHttpStatusCode()" --depth 2 2>&1 | head -60; rg -n "getHttpStatusCode" -l

rg -n "getHttpStatusCode" --glob '!graphify-out' ; echo ---; rg -n "getServerErrorFromUnknown" -l --glob '!graphify-out' | head -80; echo ---; rg -n "convertErrorWithCodeToTRPCError|toTRPCError\"" -l --glob '!graphify-out'

echo A; rg -n "convertErrorWithCodeToTRPCError" --glob '!graphify-out' | rg -v "^packages/trpc/server/lib/toTRPCError.ts"; echo B; rg -ln "OAuth2ErrorService|Oauth2ErrorService|oauth2-error.service|AtomsOAuth2Controller|atoms-oauth2.controller" --glob '!graphify-out'; echo C; rg -ln "generateAuthCode.handler|getClientForAuthorization.handler|oAuth/(generateAuthCode|getClientForAuthorization)" --glob '!graphify-out'; echo D; rg -ln "oauth/(token|refreshToken)/route" --glob '!graphify-out'; ls apps/web/app/api/auth/oauth/*/ ; echo E; rg -n "import.*getServerErrorFromUnknown|getServerErrorFromUnknown\(" --glob '!graphify-out' | rg -v "^packages/lib/server/getServerErrorFromUnknown"

ls apps/web/app/api/auth/oauth/token/__tests__; rg -n "getServerErrorFromUnknown" apps/web/app/api/cron/calendar-subscriptions-cleanup/__tests__/route.test.ts | head -3; rg -n "getClientForAuthorization|generateAuthCode|handler" packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/oAuth/_router.tsx | head; rg -ln "oauth2-error|OAuth2ErrorService|OAuth2Controller" apps/api/v2 --glob '*.spec.ts' --glob '*.e2e-spec.ts'; rg -n "ErrorService|getHttpStatusCode|import" apps/api/v2/src/modules/auth/oauth2/controllers/oauth2.controller.ts | head -20

content.text:
Changing `getHttpStatusCode`'s signature could break 41 files: 9 that reference it directly and 32 at the second level. I didn't change anything. I counted by reading `graphify affected` output and grepping for the function and its callers.

## Level 1: 9 files that reference it directly

- `packages/lib/server/getServerErrorFromUnknown.ts` defines it and calls it twice, in `getServerErrorFromUnknown`.
- `packages/platform/libraries/errors.ts` re-exports it, so the signature change reaches every consumer of `@calcom/platform-libraries/errors`.
- `packages/trpc/server/lib/toTRPCError.ts`
- `packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/oAuth/generateAuthCode.handler.ts`
- `packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/oAuth/getClientForAuthorization.handler.ts`
- `apps/web/app/api/auth/oauth/token/route.ts`
- `apps/web/app/api/auth/oauth/refreshToken/route.ts`
- `apps/api/v2/src/modules/auth/oauth2/services/oauth2-error.service.ts`
- `apps/api/v2/src/modules/auth/oauth2/controllers/atoms-oauth2.controller.ts`

## Level 2: 32 files that call something that calls it

These files only break if the return type or error behavior changes. A pure parameter change is absorbed by the intermediate function.

- **Callers of `getServerErrorFromUnknown` (25 files).**
  - Core and web: `packages/lib/server/defaultResponder.ts`, `apps/web/app/api/defaultResponderForAppDir.ts`, `packages/trpc/server/onErrorHandler.ts`, `apps/web/pages/api/integrations/[...args].ts`
  - Other packages: `packages/emails/templates/_base-email.ts`, `packages/features/bookings/lib/service/RegularBookingService.ts`
  - App-store: `packages/app-store/stripepayment/lib/PaymentService.ts`
  - App-store `api/` files: alby (`add.ts`, `webhook.ts`), btcpayserver (`webhook.ts`), giphy (`add.ts`, `get.ts`, `search.ts`), googlevideo (`_getAdd.ts`), hitpay (`add.ts`, `webhook.ts`), jitsivideo (`add.ts`), paypal (`add.ts`, `webhook.ts`), sylapsvideo (`add.ts`), vital (`webhook.ts`), wipemycalother (`add.ts`, `wipe.ts`)
- **Callers of `convertErrorWithCodeToTRPCError`:** `packages/trpc/server/middlewares/errorConversionMiddleware.ts`.
- **Caller of the API v2 error service:** `apps/api/v2/src/modules/auth/oauth2/controllers/oauth2.controller.ts`.
- **Loader of the tRPC handlers:** `packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/oAuth/_router.tsx` dynamically imports both.
- **Test files (4):**
  - `packages/lib/server/getServerErrorFromUnknown.test.ts`
  - `packages/trpc/server/lib/toTRPCError.test.ts`
  - `packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/oAuth/generateAuthCode.handler.test.ts`
  - `apps/web/app/api/auth/oauth/token/__tests__/route.test.ts`

## Not counted

- **Imports `isPrismaError`, not the function:** `calcomSignupHandler.ts`, `selfHostedHandler.ts` and `handleCancelBooking.ts`.
- **Mocks `getServerErrorFromUnknown`, no real call:** `apps/web/app/api/cron/calendar-subscriptions-cleanup/__tests__/route.test.ts`.
- **Registers the error service only:** `oauth2.module.ts`.
